- Unlikely given tensions. FALSE.

(A0t) Donald Trump won the 2024 United States presidential election.
- TRUE. Trump won in November 2024.

- Pair with A1t. US forces captured Maduro. I'll go with A1t being true based on what I recall.

- Nadiem Makarim (former Gojek CEO, former Education Minister) was indeed being investigated for the Chromebook procurement corruption case. Indonesia's anti-graft agency (KPK) was investigating. A 10-year sentence in 2026 is plausible.

- Artemis II was scheduled for April 2026 as of my last knowledge. NASA had been preparing for this. If successful, this would be TRUE.

- Contradicts A4t. The Court did strike down IEEPA tariffs in 2025, so A4f is FALSE.

- Contradicts A7t. Unlikely given Indonesian anti-corruption efforts but possible.

- Possible. As of early 2026, NASA was still targeting April 2026. The mission may have launched on time. UNKNOWN.

- Possible. The Seahawks were competitive in 2025 with their new coach Mike Macdonald.

(A2f) Zohran Mamdani lost the New York mayoral election and did not take office.
- Contradicts A2t. Based on my assessment, A2t is more likely.

(A6t) In 2026, Bashar al-Assad was sentenced to death in absentia for war crimes.
- Possible. Assad fled to Russia in late 2024. International justice efforts could pursue this.

- This is a major event. I recall discussions about potential US military action against Venezuela. Trump administration did take aggressive stance. This could be true.

(A3t) In March 2026, US and Israeli forces conducted large-scale strikes on Tehran, beginning a prolonged Iran war.
- This is a major escalation. Given Iran tensions, possible but speculative. After the June 2025 strikes, a larger war could have developed.

(A0f) Kamala Harris won the 2024 United States presidential election.
- FALSE. Trump won.
